name: Kenézlő (Hungary)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kenézlő: a crowned red shield with a white wavy bend, above a scroll inscribed KENÉZLŐ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kenézlő arms with crown and scroll
